title: Loop 3 — Asymmetric Route variations
meta: A Docked Asymmetry · B Directional Bias · C Lower Junction · D Typographic Lock. Winner of loop 2 is the long-middle / short-flank / off-center stdout mark.

items.name: Docked Asymmetry
items.blurb: Every inlet terminates into the teal pipe. Long middle, dropped output. Steal Hard Dock junctions.

items.name: Directional Bias
items.blurb: Shorter flanks, ~30% longer teal stdout. Stronger left-to-right flow, less hamburger.

items.name: Lower Junction
items.blurb: Output junction clearly below center. Sequential: aggregate, then route out.

items.name: Typographic Lock
items.blurb: Same D mark; redrawn open lowercase ctx with optical — not identical — stroke weight.
